verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect documents a per-seller balance API: a retrieve-balance call made as the connected account. That covers a thin slice of automatable reconciliation. The pack has nothing on settlement or reconciliation reports, rolled-up platform reporting, or scheduled file or report delivery. The payout scheduling and webhooks it mentions are adjacent features, not reports. Missing for 10: settlement/reconciliation reports per seller, rolled-up platform-level reports, scheduled report delivery as files, and independent corroboration of finance-stack integration.

support.subject: As a developer, reconciliation is automatable — settlement and balance reports per seller and rolled up, delivered as files or APIs my finance stack consumes on schedule

citations.quote: To check the balance of a connected account, perform a retrieve balance call authenticated as the connected account.
